The Riordanverse (The newest books aside) is pretty good, the Magnus Chase and the Kane Chronicles need more love, they're pretty fun reads and you don't need to know the rest of the books to have fun reading them, book 3 of the Magnus Chase books does have spoilers for Heroes of Olympus and Trials of Apollo where as the Kane chronicles don't have any spoilers in the main series as far as I can remember. I don't remember much about the golden compass but i do remember liking the setting. If you aren't asking from that list: Fazbear Frights are interesting and have some silly stories, stupid stories, and Springtrap Mpreg Technically middle school level books: Goosebumps are a group of interesting mild horror books I survived is good for learning about big disasters (I think there's one for 9/11?)
